name: Beehiiv
label: Beehiiv — publications, subscriptions, posts (REST v2)
description: Official Beehiiv REST v2 at https://api.beehiiv.com/v2. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Bearer api_token. Offset page is deprecated (max 100 pages); prefer cursor. Webhooks on Scale+. Customer owns the Beehiiv publication. api_token is never logged. https://developers.beehiiv.com/welcome/pagination
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Set operation to override config.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT catalog verb.

schema.label: publicationId
schema.description: Prefixed pub_ id.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Subscriber email for create. Consent/double opt-in is the caller’s responsibility.

schema.label: reactivate_existing
schema.description: Per-operation field `reactivate_existing`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: send_welcome_email
schema.description: Per-operation field `send_welcome_email`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: utm_source
schema.description: Per-operation field `utm_source`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: custom_fields
schema.description: Per-operation field `custom_fields`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: double_opt_override
schema.description: Per-operation field `double_opt_override`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: tier
schema.description: Per-operation field `tier`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: subscriptionId
schema.description: Prefixed sub_ id.

schema.label: expand
schema.description: Optional expansions (stats, custom_fields, …).

schema.label: premium_tier_ids
schema.description: Per-operation field `premium_tier_ids`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Per-operation field `limit`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Offset page (deprecated by beehiiv; max 100 pages). Prefer `cursor`. https://developers.beehiiv.com/welcome/pagination

schema.label: cursor
schema.description: Cursor-based pagination token (preferred). https://developers.beehiiv.com/welcome/pagination

schema.label: status
schema.description: Per-operation field `status`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: platform
schema.description: Per-operation field `platform`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: order_by
schema.description: Per-operation field `order_by`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

schema.label: postId
schema.description: Post id.

schema.label: url
schema.description: Webhook callback URL (Scale+). Inbound events still use trigger.listen / BPMN ingress.

schema.label: event_types
schema.description: Webhook event type list (subscription.created, post.sent, …).

schema.label: description
schema.description: Per-operation field `description`. Omit when unused. Never put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Exact 'ok' on HTTP 2xx.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream status code.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Provider JSON body. Minimize retained PII.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: subscription.create | subscription.get | subscription.update | subscription.delete | post.list | post.get | publication.get | webhook.create | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: Publication Id
configurationParameters.description: Prefixed publication id (pub_…). Used as path {publicationId} when INPUT omits it.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
